ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Regsvr32 Commandline Flag Anomaly
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a potential command line flag anomaly related to "regsvr32" in which the "/i" flag is used without the "/n" which should be uncommon.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-i\\:.*")) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-n\\ .*"))
